app/api/test-nivoda/route.ts.name: Nivoda connection test
app/api/test-nivoda/route.ts.description: Tests the connection to the Nivoda diamond marketplace and optionally runs a sample diamond search.

app/api/tmc-matches/route.ts.name: TMC ring matching
app/api/tmc-matches/route.ts.description: Lists and saves which Elysium rings map to equivalent pieces in the TMC supplier catalogue.

app/api/tmc-review/route.ts.name: TMC ring review decisions
app/api/tmc-review/route.ts.description: Lists and saves staff decisions on which TMC supplier rings to keep, with pricing, notes and configuration options.

POST /api/test-nivoda.name: Test Nivoda connection
POST /api/test-nivoda.description: Connects to the Nivoda diamond marketplace with the given credentials and optionally searches for sample diamonds.

GET /api/test-nivoda.name: Nivoda status check
GET /api/test-nivoda.description: Returns a quick health check showing the Nivoda diamond marketplace is reachable.

GET /api/tmc-matches.name: List ring matches
GET /api/tmc-matches.description: Returns the mapping of Elysium rings to their TMC supplier equivalents.

POST /api/tmc-matches.name: Save ring match
POST /api/tmc-matches.description: Links an Elysium ring to its matching piece in the TMC supplier catalogue.

GET /api/tmc-review.name: List ring reviews
GET /api/tmc-review.description: Returns every staff review decision on TMC supplier rings, including keep/skip, pricing and notes.

POST /api/tmc-review.name: Save ring review
POST /api/tmc-review.description: Records a staff decision on a TMC supplier ring and notifies the team when a new piece is added.
